card.text: Explore Hartley 2's published EPOXI nucleus model and its source constraints.

introduction.text: EPOXI passed Hartley 2 in 2010. A smooth waist joins its two rough lobes, while jets carry gas, dust and icy particles away from the nucleus.

constraints.title: Shape-constraint map
constraints.summary: Shape measurements mapped onto the nucleus. Solid gray marks stereo measurements, blue marks limb outlines, and the grid marks poorly constrained regions.

model.title: Nucleus shape reconstruction
model.summary: The published nucleus shape, simplified for display. Gray is a model material; the grid marks regions with weaker shape constraints.

mri.title: EPOXI mosaic
mri.summary: MRI views and restored HRI close-ups show the smooth waist and rough lobes. The photographs retain their shadows; the grid marks gaps or uncertain shape.
